title: File and URL analysis: VirusTotal, urlscan, any.run, Joe Sandbox and WHOIS

videos.script: Somebody forwards a file and asks if it is safe. The instinct is to upload it somewhere. {{publish}} An upload to a public service is a publication. If the file was a client's, that is a leak. {{local}} So you start on your own machine. What the file really is, its hash, the text inside it. Nothing leaves. {{hash}} Then you search for the hash, which tells nobody anything. {{services}} Only then the online services. VirusTotal for files, urlscan for links, the sandboxes for behaviour, and the registration record for domains. {{indicators}} Each one turns a suspicious thing into something the earlier lessons can block.
